sources.title: GitHub - aabbdev/rwkv-publisher
sources.snippet: This repository builds standalone Hugging Face model repositories for official BlinkDL RWKV-7 Goose checkpoints. It is deliberately separate from both Hugging Face Transformers and the RWKV7 PyTorch runtime repository.

sources.title: RWKV Language Model
sources.snippet: RWKV (pronounced RwaKuv) is an RNN with great LLM performance and parallelizable like a Transformer. Check RWKV-7 "Goose" reasoning models. It's combining the best of RNN and transformer - great performance, linear time, constant space (no kv-cache), fast training, infinite ctxlen, and free text embedding. And it's 100% attention-free, and a Linux Foundation AI project.
